scope: controlled repaired query-stage evaluation on frozen actual-mono A histories collected with the previous executor
covisibility: maximum directed goal-surface visibility across every eligible pre-query history frame
selection: minimum sha256 of seed/history/bin/yaw_index; never by model outputs or proximity to bin center
natural_novel_control: retain frozen original query, report separately without relabeling or replacement
task_unit: one history and one query, all three arms paired on the same A100
primary_comparison: cec minus native per support bin
secondary_comparison: cec minus raw_fixed per support bin
multiple_comparisons: Holm correction across five bins separately for each comparison family
